This is a sample text file for testing the TXT loader.

It contains multiple paragraphs to verify that the extraction
preserves the full content.

Key Concepts:
- Concept 1: Process scheduling determines which process runs next.
- Concept 2: Deadlock occurs when processes wait for each other indefinitely.
- Concept 3: Virtual memory allows processes to use more memory than physically available.

Important Definitions:
A process is an instance of a program in execution.
A thread is a lightweight subprocess within a process.

This file is used by the automated test suite.
